```yaml
name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    env:
      TAG_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --distpath dist --name a2a-scanner a2a_scanner.py

      - name: Create tar.gz archive
        run: |
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-macos-arm64-${TAG_NAME}.tar.gz -C dist a2a-scanner

      - name: Upload asset to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: a2a-scanner-macos-arm64-${TAG_NAME}.tar.gz
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-macos-arm64-${TAG_NAME}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Compute SHA256 of archive
        id: sha
        run: |
          SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 a2a-scanner-macos-arm64-${TAG_NAME}.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "SHA256=$SHA256" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Clone Homebrew tap
        run: |
          git clone https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}@github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git tap
          cd tap
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        run: |
          cd tap
          FORMULA=Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          # Update version
          sed -i '' "s/^  version \".*\"/  version \"${TAG_NAME}\"/" $FORMULA
          # Update sha256
          sed -i '' "s/^  sha256 \".*\"/  sha256 \"${{ env.SHA256 }}\"/" $FORMULA
          git add $FORMULA
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to ${TAG_NAME}"
          git push origin main
```
